meaning.en: A piece of land on which a house is to be built or has been built.
meaning.vi: Một mảnh đất mà trên đó một ngôi nhà sẽ được xây dựng hoặc đã được xây dựng.

meaning.en: The plot of land on which a house is or can be built.
meaning.vi: Lô đất đã hoặc có thể xây nhà.

sentences.en: Claims for these policies are handled by Homesite Insurance Group.

sentences.en: Although flood insurance is not required in all cases, it is still an important coverage to consider purchasing and is usually relatively inexpensive.Progressive sells flood insurance through Homesite Insurance.
